description: This file defines the API and structures for managing file write-locks used by Git, including functions for creating, committing, rolling back, and managing lockfiles, along with signal handling and error reporting mechanisms.

classes.name: lock_file
classes.description: Represents a lockfile object, encapsulating a tempfile used for locking operations.

methods.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout_mode
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile for the specified path with timeout and mode, returning a file descriptor or -1 on error.

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms)
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile with a specified timeout, default mode 0666.

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags)
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile without timeout.

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update_mode(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,int mode)
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile with specified mode.

methods.name: int is_lock_file_locked(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Checks if the lockfile is currently active/locked.

methods.name: unable_to_lock_message
methods.description: Appends an error message related to lock failures into a buffer.

methods.name: unable_to_lock_die
methods.description: Emits an error message and terminates the program if locking fails.

methods.name: FILE * fdopen_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk,const char * mode)
methods.description: Associates a FILE stream with the lockfile for standard I/O operations.

methods.name: const char * get_lock_file_path(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path of the lockfile.

methods.name: int get_lock_file_fd(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the lockfile.

methods.name: FILE * get_lock_file_fp(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Returns the FILE pointer of the lockfile.

methods.name: get_locked_file_path
methods.description: Returns the path of the file that is being locked by the lockfile.

methods.name: int close_lock_file_gently(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Closes the lockfile and associated resources without deleting or renaming.

methods.name: int reopen_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Reopens a lockfile that was previously closed with `close_lock_file_gently`.

methods.name: commit_lock_file
methods.description: Commits the lockfile by closing and renaming it to final destination.

methods.name: int commit_lock_file_to(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path)
methods.description: Commits the lockfile, moving it to a specified path.

methods.name: int rollback_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Rolls back the lockfile by closing and removing it.

ctags.name: commit_lock_file_to
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int commit_lock_file_to(struct lock_file *lk, const char *path)$/

ctags.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_mode
ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,int mode)

ctags.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout
ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms)
